downstreamNote: DOWNSTREAM MEASUREMENT, NOT A RATIFICATION. Re-measured from source on this tree -- neither parent branch's fixture is correct here. Same tokenizer identity and the same floor(0.50 * mutableProseBaseline) policy; only measurements moved, never the policy, tokenizer, primary variant, or inclusion/exclusion lists.
